data.jobspec:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
#FLUX --job-name=dockerMap # A single job name for the array
#FLUX --cpus-per-task=7
#FLUX --ntasks=1 # This script is a template for one task of a job array
#FLUX --nodes=1 # on one node
#FLUX --time=24:00:00
#FLUX --mem-per-task=60G
#FLUX --queue=standard
#FLUX --account=berglandlab

# NOTE: The SLURM --array directive was omitted. Flux handles job arrays at
# submission time. This script should be submitted using 'flux bulksubmit',
# for example:
# flux bulksubmit -n 16 --cc=1-16 --output=./slurmOutput/RunDest.{id}_{task[id]}.out --error=./slurmOutput/RunDest.{id}_{task[id]}.err ./your_script_name.sh
# The script will then execute 16 times with FLUX_JOB_ARRAY_TASK_ID set from 1 to 16.
# The output/error directives below are a fallback for single-job submission.
#FLUX -o ./slurmOutput/RunDest.{id}.out # Standard output
#FLUX -e ./slurmOutput/RunDest.{id}.err # Standard error

pwd
# The SLURM variable $SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK is replaced by the Flux equivalent.
echo $FLUX_JOB_CPUS_PER_TASK 

### modules
module load singularity

###################################
# Part  0. Get Sample information #
###################################

# The SLURM variable $SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID is replaced by the Flux equivalent.
sampleid=$( cat mapping.data.only.collapsed.txt  | sed '1d' | awk '{ print $1 }' | sed "${FLUX_JOB_ARRAY_TASK_ID}q;d" )

numFlies=$( cat mapping.data.only.collapsed.txt  | sed '1d' | awk '{ print $2 }' | sed "${FLUX_JOB_ARRAY_TASK_ID}q;d" )

echo $sampleid
echo $numFlies

###################################
# Part  2. Run Docker             #
###################################

singularity run \
/scratch/yey2sn/DEST/dest_freeze1_latest.sif \
${sampleid}/${sampleid}.joint_1.fastq \
${sampleid}/${sampleid}.joint_2.fastq \
${sampleid} \
/project/berglandlab/DEST/dest_mapped/RECENT_OUTPUTS \
--cores $FLUX_JOB_CPUS_PER_TASK \
--max-cov 0.95 \
--min-cov 4 \
--base-quality-threshold 25 \
--num-flies ${numFlies} \
--do_poolsnp \
--do_snape

echo "done"
date

issues: The script specifies output and error files to be written to a subdirectory (`./slurmOutput/`). However, the script does not contain a command to create this directory (e.g., `mkdir -p ./slurmOutput`). If the directory does not exist at job launch time, the job will fail because it cannot open its log files.

The script is designed for job array submission and relies on the `FLUX_JOB_ARRAY_TASK_ID` variable. If a user mistakenly submits this script as a single job (e.g., using `flux submit`), the variable will be unset. This will cause the `sed "${FLUX_JOB_ARRAY_TASK_ID}q;d"` command to behave incorrectly, likely resulting in all jobs processing the same first line of the input file.

#SBATCH -N 1 # on one node
#SBATCH -t 24:00:00
#SBATCH --mem 60G
#SBATCH -o ./slurmOutput/RunDest.%A_%a.out # Standard output
#SBATCH -e ./slurmOutput/RunDest.%A_%a.err # Standard error
#SBATCH -p standard
#SBATCH --account berglandlab
#SBATCH --array=1-16

pwd
echo $SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK 

### modules
module load singularity

###################################
# Part  0. Get Sample information #
###################################

sampleid=$( cat mapping.data.only.collapsed.txt  | sed '1d' | awk '{ print $1 }' | sed "${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID}q;d" )

numFlies=$( cat mapping.data.only.collapsed.txt  | sed '1d' | awk '{ print $2 }' | sed "${SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID}q;d" )

echo $sampleid
echo $numFlies

###################################
# Part  2. Run Docker             #
###################################

singularity run \
/scratch/yey2sn/DEST/dest_freeze1_latest.sif \
${sampleid}/${sampleid}.joint_1.fastq \
${sampleid}/${sampleid}.joint_2.fastq \
${sampleid} \
/project/berglandlab/DEST/dest_mapped/RECENT_OUTPUTS \
--cores $SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK \
--max-cov 0.95 \
--min-cov 4 \
--base-quality-threshold 25 \
--num-flies ${numFlies} \
--do_poolsnp \
--do_snape

echo "done"
date
